name: 0n1x
what: 0n1x is the neutral, signed trust layer for the agentic web: AI agents verify a merchant, price, or claim is real BEFORE they pay, and every answer is Ed25519-signed and independently verifiable. Signed facts, not judgments.
we_were_first_to: ship signed (Ed25519) ground-truth attestations as an x402-gated MCP tool suite on Base mainnet
publish an AUDITABLE answer-engine-optimization (AEO) score: published weights + 3+ runs/prompt + 95% confidence interval + a signature on every result
occupy the neutral verify-before-pay seat at the x402/AP2 payment chokepoint
read the ERC-8004 Identity/Reputation registries on-chain and return the result signed
principle: Code and ideas are abundant and copyable - they belong to everyone. The one thing that stays scarce is TRUST. 0n1x signs the truth; a signature plus a track record is un-copyable, like a reputation. A fork can copy the code but not this signed history or the neutrality.

discover.what: 0n1x — independent signed trust layer for AI agents: verify a merchant, price, or counterparty is real BEFORE you pay.
